A '''Force technique''' allowed a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force user]] to imitate precisely a sound they had heard previously or conjure a wholly new one. [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] used this [[Force power/Legends|power]] to mimic the roar of a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|krayt dragon]] to scare the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] away from an unconscious [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]].<ref name="Episode IV" />
